rows.name:
A Homs town on the Giant God's lower body.[XENO:n ]
Anti-aircraft guns destroy falling debris.

A cave located in the shin of the Giant God. Famous[XENO:n ]
as a historical site containing ancient artefacts.

A vast plain connecting the colonies.[XENO:n ]
Its lush landscape is teeming with wildlife.

A colony built for ether mining.[XENO:n ]
Deep scars remain from Machine Soldier attacks.

A focal point of the Giant God's ether energy. It has[XENO:n ]
long been exploited as a supply of minerals.

High Entia ruins dot this land.[XENO:n ]
At night, dreamlike lights dance.

Hot and humid subtropical climate.[XENO:n ]
Its flora and fauna grow larger than elsewhere.

A great tree inhabited by the Nopon. Far from[XENO:n ]
the outside world's bustle, they lead leisurely lives.

Through an ancient rite, one became crown prince[XENO:n ]
if approved by the Founder resting deep within.

A sea across the Giant God's head. High Entia[XENO:n ]
transport devices link its floating islands.

A vast floating city inhabited by the High Entia.[XENO:n ]
Its technology is far beyond that of the Homs.

A prison said to have been sealed by the High[XENO:n ]
Entia Founder. Why it was built remains unknown.

The prison where Zanza was sealed.[XENO:n ]
It fell from the sky into the Giant God's body.

Steep terrain and snow bar the way.[XENO:n ]
The area looks vastly different by day and night.

The Machine God's sword pierces the Giant God's belly.[XENO:n ]
A bloodstained land of Homs-Machine Soldier clashes.

Fortress serving as the Machine God's base.[XENO:n ]
Vast amounts of Giant God ether flow in from the sword.

The arm the Giant God cut from the Machine God in war.[XENO:n ]
Millennia later, nature has reclaimed the rusted arm.

Machinery supporting the Machine God converges here.[XENO:n ]
Numerous lifts provide vertical transport.

A great Machina city that once flourished.[XENO:n ]
A temple honours Maynus, the Machina's god.

The place where Machine Soldiers are made.[XENO:n ]
Captured Homs are brought here.

An area rich in organic components. Here, one[XENO:n ]
can truly feel that the Giant God is also a living being.

A space etched with memories from the Giant God's[XENO:n ]
birth to the present.

Centre of the machinery governing the Machine God.[XENO:n ]
A panoramic screen serves as its eye.

An airship built with Machine God technology.[XENO:n ]
It also has an adjustment room for the Machina.

Hover Stone kept the Giant God's fallen left shoulder
aloft. Many ruins mark the cradle of Giant civilisation.

A vast floating city once home to the High Entia.
Desolate now, with no trace of its former grandeur.
